usage: __main__.py [-h] --bed BED --genome GENOME [--kmer-size KMER_SIZE]
                   --output OUTPUT

Build a k-mer array file from a BED file and reference genome FASTA.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --bed BED             Input BED file of genomic regions
  --genome GENOME       Reference genome FASTA
  --kmer-size KMER_SIZE
                        k-mer size (default: 8)
  --output OUTPUT       Output array file
